content.text:
* Low-voltage PMOS LDO with capacitive local feedback around error amplifier
.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
* Matched input level shifting: 0.3 VIN + 0.7 VREF at equilibrium
RREFH VIN IR 700k
RREFL VREF IR 300k
RFBH VIN IFB 700k
RFBOUT VOUT IFB 600k
RFBLO IFB VSS 600k
CREFH VIN IR 2.4p
CREFL VREF IR 5.6p
CFBH VIN IFB 2.4p
CFBOUT VOUT IFB 3.6p
CFBLO IFB VSS 2p
* Resistor-fed current reference and fivefold tail mirror
RB VIN NB 85k
XNB NB NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL NS NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* Load-dependent auxiliary tail current
XSENSE NA GP VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1 m=1
XAB NA NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBOOST NS NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS pair and PMOS current-mirror load
XFB ND IFB NS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XREF GP IR NS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XPL ND ND VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.25 nf=1 m=4
XPR GP ND VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.25 nf=1 m=4
* Local AC feedback limits high-frequency gain while preserving DC precision
CLOCAL GP IR 0.4p
* Pass transistor and output discharge path
XPASS VOUT GP VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=4
RBLEED VOUT VSS 50k
.ends DUT
